note: Solid bars: measured on Apple M1 Pro, 2026-10-14, on seeded subsets (seed 0) of three ViDoRe v1 test sets at pinned revisions: 100 queries and 200 pages each (the queries' relevant pages plus random others), so every retriever ranks the same 200 pages. OCR: Tesseract 5.4.1 (LSTM, English, --psm 3) on each page image as ViDoRe ships it. Text retrieval: BM25 (bm25s, Lucene variant, k1 1.2, b 0.75, stemming) and bge-small-en-v1.5 over the whole OCR page. Page images: vidore/colSmol-256M with colpali-engine 0.3.18, float32 on the CPU (the MPS runs failed on the shared machine: one segfaulted while loading, one had not finished 500 InfoVQA pages after 30 minutes, with the 16 GB of memory deep in swap). nDCG@5 with one relevant page per query; ± is half the 95% bootstrap interval over queries. Lighter bar: BM25 over OCR on the full set (500, 500 and 977 pages), for scale. Dashed bars: the ColPali paper's Table 2 (the authors' runs on the full sets: Unstructured with OCR, the paper citing the Tesseract overview, or with captions written by Claude 3 Sonnet; and ColPali 3B), not a reproduction. Scripts: src/scripts/vidore_*.py.
